propositions: Empty file_impact field conflates two distinct states: author forgot to declare vs. ticket genuinely touches no files; a third explicit state is needed
FILE_IMPACT event payload must carry optional keys file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason; reducer state derivation resolves three mutually exclusive states from event data
set-file-impact CLI command must migrate from _REGISTRY to _ARGV_REGISTRY to support both positional JSON array form (unchanged) and new --none flag with required reason string
Reason validation enforces minimum 10 non-whitespace characters; violations exit 2 without writing an event
New library function get_file_impact_scope returns tri-state kind (undeclared/paths/none) with reason and paths; new MCP tool declare_no_file_impact applies identical reason validation
rebar show output must surface both file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys from reducer state; state transitions between any pair of three states must preserve consistency
